The President may transfer a High Court judge from one High Court to another after consultation with the Chief Justice of India.

items: Article 222 is frequently asked in relation to judicial transfers between High Courts.
Note that the power of transfer lies with the President, subject to consultation with the Chief Justice of India.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 222 of the Indian Constitution governs the transfer of High Court judges.
The President has the power to transfer a judge from one High Court to another High Court.
Transfer can only occur after consultation with the Chief Justice of India.
